name: DB Table Viewer
author: Vrutika Darji

sections.description:
DB Table Viewer is a simple, read-only plugin that allows administrators to:

  • Select any table in the WordPress database.
  • View its data in a clean, paginated HTML table.
  • Navigate through rows using AJAX-based pagination.

This plugin is particularly useful for debugging or inspecting custom database tables without writing SQL queries.

Features

  • Dropdown to select from available database tables.
  • Displays table data in a well-formatted, horizontally scrollable table.
  • AJAX-based pagination that stays fast on large tables.
  • Long values are shortened with a “Show more” toggle; NULL and binary values are clearly marked.
  • Secure: nonce-protected requests, strict table validation and escaped output.
  • Fully translation-ready.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the db-table-viewer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Tools > DB Table Viewer to use the plugin.
sections.faq:
Who can use this plugin?

Only administrators with the manage_options capability. On Multisite, only super admins can use it, because all sites share one database.

Can this plugin modify database data?

No, the plugin is read-only and does not allow any modifications to the database.

What happens if I select a table with no data?

The table’s columns are shown along with a message that the table is empty.
sections.changelog:
1.1

  • Security: added nonce verification to AJAX requests.
  • Security: table names are now validated against the database’s table list.
  • Security: on Multisite, access is restricted to super admins.
  • Fix: pagination now shows a compact page range instead of one button per page.
  • Fix: empty tables show their column headers.
  • Fix: invalid or out-of-range page numbers no longer cause SQL errors.
  • Fix: PHP notices for missing request parameters and placeholder-less prepared queries.
  • Improvement: long values are truncated with a “Show more” toggle; NULL and binary values are labelled.
  • Improvement: wide tables scroll horizontally.
  • Improvement: all JavaScript strings are translatable.
  • Improvement: prefixed AJAX action, class and CSS names to avoid conflicts with other plugins.

1.0

  • Initial release.
